title: Seed-floor map-diameter guard uses w²+h² but the grid's widest spacing is (w-1)²+(h-1)², so a never-clearable floor can still load
detail: Guard only rejects seed ≥ 50 (2401 < 2500 passes for 49), but tiles span [0,39]×[0,29] — max distance² is 39²+29²=2362. new_area_seed_tiles 49 loads, growth_seed_sep_ok can never pass, so growth silently stalls once estates hit cap — the exact failure the check exists to prevent.
recommended_fix: Reject when seed² > (w-1)²+(h-1)² in i64 (the true widest tile spacing) instead of w²+h²; keep the named-key error (ODN-5).
